summary: Fat Pete's BBQ identity is confirmed at 3407 Connecticut Avenue NW in Washington, DC. The current catalog consolidates 66 products from 137 frozen structured rows. Every frozen row reconciles once; the excess consists mainly of pizza toppings, size/portion choices, sauce modifiers, and duplicate side or pizza-size presentations. No comprehensive allergen matrix was found after all four searches; direct official ingredient positives are preserved without unsupported absence or cross-contact claims.
proposedChanges: Remove size, portion, sauce, and pizza-topping modifier rows from the product catalog.
Collapse pizza sizes into presentation references under each pizza product.
Consolidate duplicate side presentations while retaining official ingredient positives.
Leave undisclosed direct allergen evidence unavailable.

findings.finding: Structured extraction promoted numerous modifiers and size choices to standalone products.
Pizza sizes and side-option presentations create equivalent duplicates.

coordinatorNotes: The Washington location and current menu share the exact official address.
No unsupported allergen-negative or cross-contact claim was made.
